steps.do: Pour white powder with {salt} and {seasoning} into the bowl containing butter on the stovetop
steps.done_when: the bowl on the stovetop contains white powder, salt and seasoning mixed with butter

steps.do: Cut open the package of {baguette_loaves} and place one loaf on the cutting board
steps.done_when: one baguette loaf rests on the cutting board with the opened package nearby

steps.do: Slice {bread_slices} from the baguette on the cutting board
steps.done_when: two even bread slices lie separated on the cutting board with the remaining loaf showing fresh cut ends

steps.do: Scoop {shredded_cheese} and {seasoning} into the bowl on the stovetop
steps.done_when: the bowl on the stovetop holds a mound of shredded cheese topped with seasoning

steps.do: Pour {olive_oil} into the frying pan on the burner
steps.done_when: the frying pan on the burner contains a shallow pool of yellow oil

steps.do: Brush {egg_wash} evenly onto both sides of {bread_slices} on the cutting board
steps.done_when: both bread slices on the cutting board appear glossy and evenly coated with yellow egg wash

steps.do: Measure {cherry_tomatoes} and rinse them under running water
steps.done_when: about eight clean cherry tomatoes sit on the cutting board with water droplets visible

steps.do: Slice the rinsed cherry tomatoes in half on the cutting board
steps.done_when: a pile of halved cherry tomatoes is spread across the cutting board

steps.do: Transfer the sliced tomatoes into the bowl and mix with the cheese and seasoning
steps.done_when: the bowl contains evenly mixed chopped tomatoes and shredded cheese

steps.do: Pan-fry {bread_slices} in the hot oiled pan, flipping until golden on both sides
steps.done_when: two golden-brown toasted bread slices sizzle in the frying pan on the glowing burner

steps.do: Transfer the fried {bread_slices} from the pan to the plate on the counter
steps.done_when: two fried bread slices rest side by side on the white patterned plate

steps.do: Spoon the tomato-cheese mixture from the bowl onto the {bread_slices} on the plate
steps.done_when: both toast slices on the plate are generously covered with chunky tomato-cheese topping and the bowl is nearly empty
